page.layout: One page of text, one column, no margin notes. Short Arabic forms are set inline in the running text and are marked illegible where I cannot read them letter by letter.

main_text.p: In medio etiā dictionis apponitur, ad indican-dum elisionem ʼ quiescentis, ut [illegible, ~4 letters] pro [illegible, ~3 letters]. Gjesmon eodem modo adhibetur ut apud Arabes, nisi quòd cùm duæ concurrant con-sonæ vocalibus destitutæ, Gjesma alterutri indifferenter apponitur, ut [illegible, ~4 letters] gjenc bellum, [illegible, ~4 letters] dest manus. Hamza autem aliter se habet quam apud Arabes; hic enim ʼ mobili non inservit, sed in fine vocum usur-patur, præcipuè earum quæ terminantur in ḍ, & ferè valet [illegible, ~2 letters]. Reliquæ notæ à Persis plerunque omittuntur.
main_text.head: SECT. IIII.
main_text.p: Præcepta Grammatica Persica primus Edidit Lud. de Dieu. in 4°. Lugd. Bat. 1639. Idem postea plenius præstitit Joh. Gravius; Cujus Elementa Persica prodierunt Londini in 4°. anno 1649.Hisce lectorem, qui penitiorem hujus linguæ cognitionem desiderat, remittimus: primò tamen necesse est, ut præceptis linguæ Arabicæ imbutus sit, qui Persicam addiscere velit. Lexicon Persicum nemo hactenus edidit; promittit tamen Doctissimus Golius in præf. ad Lex Arab.

page.notes: The Arabic words in the first two sentences and the vowel-marked Arabic forms are not legible letter by letter at this scan resolution, so they are marked illegible. The sign ḍ before "& ferè valet" is a printed Arabic letter ḍ-form, read here as a Latin-set mark; treat it as doubtful. The printed page number is "(94)" in italic brackets. Printing error left as printed: "1649.Hisce" has no space after the stop.
